faq.domanda: What types of paper printing products do you offer?
faq.risposta: We offer a wide range of paper printing products, including business cards, flyers, leaflets, brochures, postcards, menus and much more. We customise every product to fit each client's specific brand and communication needs.

faq.domanda: How long does paper printing take to produce?
faq.risposta: Production time depends on the type of product and the quantity ordered. Orders of 500/1000 pieces are generally completed in 5 to 7 working days, while more complex orders may need a few days more.

faq.domanda: Can I see a preview of the design before printing?
faq.risposta: Yes. Once the job is confirmed, we always provide a digital preview of the design to make sure the final product is exactly as you want it. We only move on to printing after your approval.

faq.domanda: What types of paper do you use for printing?
faq.risposta: We use various high-quality papers, such as coated, matte and recycled stock, plus special papers for premium products. The choice depends on the type of product and the effect you want to achieve.

faq.domanda: What finishing options do you offer for printed products?
faq.risposta: Our finishing options include gloss or matte lamination, UV coating, embossing, special die-cuts and binding. These options add a professional, distinctive touch to your printed products.

faq.domanda: Do you offer design services for paper printing products?
faq.risposta: Yes, we also offer graphic design services to help you create a professional, eye-catching layout. We can work alongside you to develop the perfect design to represent your brand.

faq.domanda: What are the standard sizes for flyers, leaflets and brochures?
faq.risposta: Standard sizes vary depending on the type of product. Flyers, for example, are usually A5 or A4, while brochures can be folded or in A4 format. We can also produce custom sizes on request.
